Jinchuuriki is the title given to a ninja who has a Bijuu (Tailed Beast) sealed within
their body. Every Tailed Beast provides its user with a reserve of chakra and raw
power, as well as special abilities that depend on the type of beast. This power works
based on active benefits, acquired through continuous use, as well as passive
benefits, acquired through its natural evolution.


Benefits Table: Each Bijuu is different and therefore has its own list of benefits. You
will automatically receive the benefits listed in the table as your power level increases.


Some Bijuu, like Shukaku (Ichibi), still possess the effects of an elemental power
mixed within the Jinchuuriki power. The elemental power also follows the benefit
table: you are only entitled to choose effects for the power at the levels specified by
the table.

The following rules are general for all types of Jinchuuriki. And at the end are the
specific benefits that the Kyuubi grants. To learn about the benefits of the other bijuu,
see the Book of Hijutsus.

Modes and Techniques: This power has modes of use and techniques. The modes
of the power (such as the Bijuu Cloak) have variable prerequisites depending on the
Bijuu.

To use this technique, you must be in Bijuu Mode or Bijuu Form. This technique
consists of firing a sphere of pure chakra that explodes upon contact with its target.


Unlike the Bijuudama, which uses the nature chakra in the environment for a
massive explosion, the Chakra Blast uses the chakra of the tailed beast itself, the
same chakra that constitutes Bijuu Mode. The technique has two types of use.


Single Shot: The user fires a single chakra shot as a standard action. At the point
of impact, a sphere-shaped explosion is created (2m in diameter per level of power
used). Everyone within the explosion's area, and the direct target of the shot, will
suffer base damage equal to 2x the level of power used.


Burst Shot: The user fires a machine gun of chakra projectiles in a straight line at
a single target. Requires a full action and costs +3 chakra points.


Initially, the technique deals the same damage as the Single Shot. If the attack is
successful, make a new hit test for every 2 power levels, and increase the
technique's damage by +2 for each success. The damage level used is always
that of the first attack.

You can keep the sand suspended in mid-air. This gives you the following advantages:


Attack from Above: You can move your sand to a region above your target before attacking
it. Doing so is a feint maneuver, and you use Dexterity in your test instead of Agility.


Transport Cloud: With a move action, you can create a cloud of sand beneath your feet (or
beneath an ally within the normal range of the power) to levitate and transport you. The
creature on the transport cloud temporarily gains the Flight skill, with a level equal to the
user's Spirit.


The cloud allows you to remain levitated and also move through the air. The cloud's
movement distance is equal to 10m + 1m per power level and is not affected by the
compartment limit rule as long as all excess spaces are occupied by the Special Sand.

The cloud has standard hardness and will be destroyed if it receives sufficient damage.


When fighting on the transport cloud, you follow the rules of Aerial Combat (see Basic
Rulebook, p. 270). You do not fall off the cloud if you are impeded, but you do fall if the cloud
is destroyed.

Suspended Barrier: When using the Barrier effect, you can create walls that float in mid-air,
useful for protecting yourself from aerial attacks. The suspended barrier has no additional
cost.

You envelop a target with a large amount of sand, completely immobilizing it. This

This effect is used at a distance and it is not necessary to remain in contact with the
target to maintain it. Only one target can be restrained at a time. From the following
turn, you can pay the chakra cost of the effect again to maintain it in a sustained manner
for that round and use Sand Funeral. You can only make the technique sustained if you
intend to use Sand Funeral.

In Bijuu Form, you can disperse a corrosive mist from your mouth that spreads in
a circular area. Anyone hit will suffer base damage equal to 2 per power level.


This technique spreads rapidly across the area and deals at least level 2 damage if the target
defended using Dodge or the Anticipate maneuver, but only if their attack roll had a damage level
of 2 or higher.


The mist remains in the area of effect for 3 turns. At the start of each of the user's
turns, all those remaining in the area will suffer 2 fixed damage per power level.


The corrosive mist possesses an imaginary hardness, the standard value of its
power. Whenever an area attack with explosions (e.g., Katon) or winds (e.g.,
Fuuton) is used on or within the mist, its hardness is reduced. If the hardness
reaches zero, the mist dissipates. The imaginary hardness follows all the common
rules for object hardness, but it does not protect against damage (the base
damage of attacks is not reduced by the imaginary hardness!).


Hiruma (Leech Surface): In Bijuu Mode, you can use this technique to expel a
corrosive liquid and cause damage to anyone in direct contact through the
Grapple maneuver. The victim will suffer 2 fixed damage per power level at the
start of each of their turns.

Reibi (Zero-Tails) — Jinchuuriki

Restricted Jinchuuriki power: Reibi is a false Bijuu fueled by negative emotions.
